resources.string: Shows a dot you move by turning the phone (gyroscope). Press Volume Down twice to touch where the dot is: release quickly to tap, keep holding to long-press, or hold and move the phone to drag and scroll. Press Volume Up twice to go Back, or to unlock when the lock screen is showing. Aim assist reads where the buttons on screen are (positions only, never text) so the dot can snap onto them; nothing leaves your phone. Needs to read the volume key and perform taps for you.
